chunks: And Muḥammad al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever does not mention the name of Allah when slaughtering, then do not eat it.

key_terms.فَلَا تَأْكُلْهُ: a prohibition against eating that slaughtered animal
key_terms.يُسَمِّ: to mention the name of Allah at the time of slaughter

ai.seo_question: Can meat be eaten if Allah’s name was not mentioned during slaughter?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding slaughtered meat: if Allah’s name is not mentioned at the time of slaughter, it is not to be eaten. It highlights the requirement of tasmiyah in lawful slaughter and its importance in determining whether meat is halal.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4189 - And Muhammad Al-Halabi narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"Whoever does not mention the name of Allah (swt) when slaughtering, do not eat (from it)."
